content.value:
Charter D520 rules that from wave 30 onward every lead act is FILED AS A TASK or it does not happen. This row carries the backlog that ruling inherits. Measured: ZERO of the six GitHub-observable wave-29 lead acts were executed, wave 28's overlapping list went unexecuted too, and the draft-twin cluster count GREW from three to four between waves. Acts requiring judgement: 0% across two waves. One-button merges: ~67%.

THE ACTS, each with its verified state.

GITHUB (all re-verified OPEN + CONFLICTING unless noted):
- Close #11007 and #11008 as SUPERSEDED. D493 already ruled it: field :transition, field :previous_sha, @transitions, the transition migration, cloud_deliveries_cmd.go and cloudclient/deliveries.go are all on origin/main.
- Rebase and merge #11169. D489: "The decide-phase action is MERGE #11169, not file a second." Its only file is contended cross-epic with #11288 (cchi-w60), which acknowledges the overlap in its own body.
- Close #11174. Superseded by the per-team slice (D487) — origin/main's digest_email_test.exs is a strict SUPERSET of #11174's, carrying the same empty-fleet test with the same 852/564/53 fixture and the same two assertions. Note #11174's red is ALSO a real test failure, not staleness.
- #10400 remains open from wave 28's list.
- DESTRUCTIVE TRAP: four of the epic's ten conflicted rows (#10173, #10407, #10496, #10522) are its own STRANDED WAVE CHARTERS, and D256-D336 exist NOWHERE on origin/main (grep returns 0). Closing them DELETES unrecorded charter history. SALVAGE THE DECISIONS BEFORE CLOSING.

BARKPARK LEDGER:
- The gyldendal chain: four rows, all open at 0/N, all last-written BEFORE D505 landed. dr-w25-hg's criterion 1 IS the team 71069eaa token rotation and is unmet; drafts.dr-w26-hg-gyldendal-operator-packet-corrected is STILL an unpublished draft, blocked by the 409 dedup wall dr-w27-bl predicted. The PUBLISH is the blocker, not the transaction.
- D507's reclaim row (dr-w28-bl-reclaim-20-...) was never refreshed: updated_at is 45 seconds after its own insert. No third row was filed, which is the one thing that went right.
- Seven drafts.* rows survive. Three are true twins of published rows and carry LOWER progress (w24-s5 7/9 vs 8/9; w27-s6 7/10 vs 9/10) so a roster read landing on a draft UNDER-REPORTS shipped work. A fourth is the orphan gyldendal packet. Three more are a 3-way cluster minted DURING wave 29 with ZERO criteria, whose published twin task-e04e0566ffc68738 is already done — so closing them would double-count a paid row. DISCARD, never close.
- dr-w28-s4-followup-payload-key-census-deferral-wait is 3/3 MET and still open — the cheapest close on the board, zero proof owed.

CONSTRAINT: the six cloud-console-hardening rows in the watch's red population are FENCED. Closing any is a fence violation, and draining all fourteen of ours still leaves nine red (charter D514). Do not promise green.
